Welcome to saber ! How may I help you?

To generate a radiology invoice, follow these steps:

1. **Choose Service for Billing**: Select the appropriate consultation or service from the service list.
2. **Select Item Code**: For billing services like radiology, select the item code or name from the list of available radiology items.
3. **Add Items**: Click on the “Add” button to include the selected radiology items in the invoice. These added items will be displayed on a grid below.
4. **Select Payment Category**: Choose the payment category for the patient.
5. **Allocate Payment Scheme**: Assign the cash or credit scheme to the patient. Use F7 for credit facility and F9 for cash facility.
6. **Utilization of Privilege Cards**: If applicable, click on ‘Prv Card’ to display all available privilege cards associated with the patient, along with their utilization details. Double-click on the card to view utilization.

These steps will help in generating a radiology invoice effectively. For further reference, you can view the image associated with this process at the following URL: [Image URL](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_113730.png).
